import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix island label variants (strip spaces, standardize case)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Fix flipper_length_mm: coerce to numeric, correct negative signs, keep valid range
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix body_mass_g: remove commas and convert to integer
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
    # Ensure year is integer
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce').astype(int)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    avg = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(k): round(float(v), 2) for k, v in avg.items()}
